name: ABC Taiwan Electronics Corp.
summary: ABC Taiwan Electronics Corp. (ABC), headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, is a leading manufacturer and global supplier of various electronic components. The company's extensive product line includes a wide range of inductive devices such as filter coils, multiple types of line filters, and power inductors (including radial, SMD, shielded, and semi-shielded configurations). They also produce multilayer chip inductors, multilayer chip beads, wound chip inductors, and axial inductors. Beyond inductive components, ABC provides transformers, MPC heat-sinks, and connectors. Furthermore, their capabilities extend to stamping and plastic molding products, as well as modern LED lighting solutions. These versatile components are vital across numerous industries, finding applications in consumer electronics, telecommunications equipment, computer and peripheral systems, industrial machinery, and automotive electronics. Established in 1979, ABC Taiwan Electronics Corp. maintains a strong international presence, with operations spanning the United States, Germany, China, and its native Taiwan.
